calls.title: Riley Draward and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The company is in a strong growth phase, having doubled revenue to $8 million last year, with a goal of reaching $16 to $20 million this year, primarily through inbound sales and enterprise deals. The customer base includes 3,000 customers, with 150 on enterprise plans. In terms of market opportunity, the company distinguishes itself as one of the few next-gen A/B testing platforms due to competitor exits. Growthbook is focusing on expanding its core A/B testing, feature flagging, and product analytics while integrating AI into developer workflows. Marketing efforts are rapidly evolving into a structured go-to-market strategy with a new website. Community engagement is driven through developer-focused content and DevRel initiatives aimed at enhancing education and inspiring the audience.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B testing, Developer Relations, Feature Flags, Product Analytics, Community Engagement
